parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in human assays against the 5-hydroxytryptamine receptor 2A (CHEMBL224). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays filtered by assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens', then to target_dictionary filtered by chembl_id = 'CHEMBL224'. Require structures via INNER JOIN compound_structures. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
